#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    long long inputNumber;
    std::cin >> inputNumber;
    int digitCount = (int)(std::log10(std::abs(inputNumber)) + 1);
    std::cout << computeCount(inputNumber, digitCount) << std::endl;

long long buildOnes(long long n) {
    return ((long long)std::pow(10, n) - 1) / 9;
}

long long computeCount(long long n, int length) {
    long long ones = buildOnes(length);
    long long total = (n / ones) * length;
    n %= ones;
    if (n == 0) return total;
    long long option1 = (length + 1) + computeCount(ones - n, length - 1);
    long long option2 = computeCount(n, length - 1);
    return total + std::min(option1, option2);
}
